name: Export Promotion Council Membership Reimbursement Scheme for Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe
benefit: **Reimbursement of Membership Fee:** Reimbursement of 80% or up to ₹20,000 (excluding GST and other applicable taxes), whichever is less, per financial year for SC/ST MSEs towards annual membership, one-time subscription, or entry fee charged by Export Promotion Councils (EPCs).
_eligibility_text: - Applicant should belong to Scheduled Caste(SC)/Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. - He/She should represent any Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs).
